TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Rejects the creation of a pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() obtains ABKOR006 with getServiceLibrary and passes getPricingruleid() to ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule; getPricingruleid() returns null when pricingRuleId is missing or cannot be converted to Long, and execute() performs no additional validations. 2. Decisions and branches: In ABKOR006Impl.executeRejectPricingRule, PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById may return null or a PricingRuleDTO; RuleDetailsUtils.populatePricingRuleDetails only populates details when rule != null; PricingRuleValidator.validateReject only allows statuses PAA, PAU or PAD; processRejection sends PAA or PAU to rejectRule with new status REJ and PAD to rejectRule with new status SYC. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: ABKOT00601ARTransaction.execute calls ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule, which reads the rule through PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById, maps it in PricingRuleMapper.mapRowToDto, loads detail rows through PricingRuleRepository.getDetailsByRuleId and resolves each detail value in PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues, validates rejection rules in PricingRuleValidator.validateReject, gets an audit id through PricingRuleRepository.getNextId, reads the request header user through getUserId, inserts the audit row through PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit and updates the rule status through PricingRuleRepository.updatePricingRuleStatus. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues throws ABKO10010004 when no query is configured for a detail entity type, when the resolved detail value is blank, or when the detail lookup raises NoResultException; PricingRuleValidator.validateReject throws ABKO10000405 when getPricingRuleById returned null; PricingRuleValidator.validateReject throws ABKO10000412 when the rule status is not PAA, PAU or PAD; PricingRuleRepository.updatePricingRuleStatus throws ABKO00000010 when the status update affects 0 rows; ABKOR006Impl.executeRejectPricingRule catches each PricingRuleException, adds the advice with addAdviceWithDescription(e.getCode(), e.getDescription()) and returns null; assignSeverityError sets Severity.EWR when getAdviceList() is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() calls setPricingrule(pricingRuleDTO) with the library response; AbstractABKOT00601ARTransaction.setPricingrule adds pricingRuleResponse only when pricingRuleDTO is not null, so the output is omitted when ABKOR006Impl.executeRejectPricingRule returns null after adding advice.
